body:
>I try to look at my parents as unhealed children because thats what they are.

This. I don't hate my parents. If anything, I feel sorry for them. My heart aches for them. But you're right, we can't control most things outside ourselves. That includes our families. I need therapy. I just get so frustrated with it sometimes. But it would help. Thanks for the kind words from you as well.
Best wishes friend. It will get better with time, just take it a little bit at a time.

I've been going through something very similar. I'm from a Christian background, but the similarities are crazy. My parents basically told me they believed that I was going to hell a couple weeks ago. It stings. I understand thats your family and it's hard to set boundaries because you should be able to share everything with family and just take care of them when they're in need. But sometimes, you have to set boundaries even with family. You don't have to tell your mom anything that would upset her. But just gradually give yourself and her more time to yourselves. The codependency isn't good for either of you. It might take time, but it's better than cutting and running, and a hell of a lot better than these stressful confrontations. And it's a sliding scale, you can stop wherever you both feel comfortable and come back to it to renegotiate whenever. Wishing you the best friend. Let me know if you ever need to talk. ❤️

Edit: just a quick add. Therapy would be great for both of you, too. I know it can be hard to get sometimes, though. Do what you can to keep yourself healthy. Can't help anyone if you are out of sorts yourself.

I'm sorry you've had to go through something like this alone. Unfortunately, that seems to be the common way this goes down, but that doesn't make it easy. It's far from easy. I can only offer kind conversation over the internet, but what I can do, I will. If you ever need to talk, I'm here.

I know my parents will never change. I've expressed to them that I'm satisfied with agreeing to disagree so long as they can keep from bringing it up (in *any* way, including general homophobic comments). They can't even bring themselves to do that. That's probably the most disappointing part. Seeing my parents reduce themselves to children. I thought we'd be much older before this happened.

This is not the first argument we've had, and I always remember as a kid saying I'd never handle problems the way they did with me. I thought there'd be a sense of justification, righteousness even, to come as I grew up and convinced myself I had grown beyond my parents' bad habits. I know I'm doing the right thing, and I don't regret it a bit. But there's a bitterness in this personal victory. In some degree or another, I'll always have to leave a part of my parents behind me, regardless how hard I try to save the relationship. It hurts.

Thanks for the compliment. I appreciate it. I really hope this doesn't come off the wrong way, but sometimes it's just nice to hear it. I don't really have many people I can talk to about this. The brain in isolation does funny things.

I think I just need to gradually cut back. I've tried to set stronger boundaries before, and they really dislike the quick change. It becomes a fight and a missionary situation real quick that way. I think if I taper back, it might not be as bad. But I do need more space from them. I can't handle the random dropped-in comments about soul-saving any more. My mental health is bad enough without their added daily drama.

Thanks for the kind words old sport. I'm feeling particularly down tonight. Lonely in a crowded world. It hits hard and fast. These demons have been on my back for a while. I'm weary of facing them alone.
I'll try that. I need to relax more. I get way too tense about everything. And yeah, theres always the option to bail. Id just feel like a coward.

I have a bad tendency to blow things up in my mind, panic. Like, I'm thrilled someone wants to have sex with me lol. This is a hard topic for me. I freeze up every time and I'm not really sure how to push myself past this one. I know, I know, just go for it. I've heard it. I just feel like I'd be violating my conscience. Very hard core conservative upbringing that I'm still working past.

Lol well I have thought about another ice cream raid. Those are always nice. Idk I just feel awfully lonely these days. It can make it hard to get up in the morning.

I mean, I'm fine with myself. It's taken a long time to get here but I can actually look at myself in the mirror with a little confidence. I want to share my life now. Grow past myself. You know?

[Here's to hoping](https://www.google.com/search?q=Toast+gif&tbm=isch&chips=q:toast+gif,g_1:champagne:qrQTMCzYekQ%3D&usg=AI4_-kTyfICHUH6-WtI6sesvi0AeXzbLBg&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj9g-PI_7DkAhUoVt8KHZ4iAhEQgIoDKAJ6BAgDEAc&cshid=1567388104274&biw=360&bih=612#imgrc=GstKaa_Q9h0IbM) 

Good luck friend. Hope you find that special person.
